test_objectives.statement: Each visible parameterized case expects abort(code, *args, **kwargs) to raise an exception.
test_objectives.condition: For every visible parameterized case in the selected test.

test_objectives.statement: App-context cases expect an exception message containing 'Aborted with {code}', while no-context cases expect one containing 'Werkzeug abort {code}'.
test_objectives.condition: According to the has_app_context branch of the selected visible test.

scenario_hypotheses.description: The context lookup returns None, so Flask delegates directly to Werkzeug's abort function with the original arguments.
scenario_hypotheses.condition: has_app_context is false and _cv_app.get(None) returns None.

scenario_hypotheses.description: The context lookup returns an object whose app aborter raises the exception expected by app-context cases, preventing Werkzeug abort from being reached.
scenario_hypotheses.condition: has_app_context is true and ctx.app.aborter raises.

scenario_hypotheses.description: If the app aborter returns normally, execution continues to Werkzeug abort because there is no return after the app-aborter call.
scenario_hypotheses.condition: _cv_app.get(None) returns a context and ctx.app.aborter returns normally.

dependency_constraints.statement: _cv_app.get(None) must return None for the no-context scenario.
dependency_constraints.condition: Only for cases intended to exercise the no-app-context path.

dependency_constraints.statement: _wz_abort must receive code, args, and kwargs and raise an exception whose message contains 'Werkzeug abort {code}'.
dependency_constraints.condition: For the selected no-app-context test cases.

dependency_constraints.statement: _cv_app.get(None) must return a context whose app is the visible mock_app for the app-context scenario.
dependency_constraints.condition: Only for cases intended to exercise an app context; the masked setup determining the lookup result is not visible.

dependency_constraints.statement: ctx.app.aborter must raise an exception whose message contains 'Aborted with {code}'.
dependency_constraints.condition: Only for the hypothesis where the app aborter supplies the visible app-context exception and stops execution.

dependency_constraints.statement: _wz_abort must raise an exception whose message contains 'Aborted with {code}' after the app aborter returns normally.
dependency_constraints.condition: Only when an app context exists and ctx.app.aborter returns normally.

expected_interactions.statement: _cv_app.get(None) is called to obtain an optional app context.
expected_interactions.condition: Whenever abort executes far enough to evaluate its context branch.
When there is no context, or when the app aborter returns normally.

verification_candidates.statement: Consider verifying the app aborter received code, args, and kwargs in app-context cases.
verification_candidates.condition: Only if the chosen scenario uses an app context and the interaction is material beyond the exception assertion.

verification_candidates.statement: Consider verifying Werkzeug abort received code, args, and kwargs in no-context cases.
verification_candidates.condition: Only for the no-context scenario and only if interaction verification adds value.

evidence.rationale: The visible test explicitly varies app-context presence, code, positional arguments, and keyword arguments.
The visible setup maps the context's app to mock_app and mock_app.aborter to mock_aborter when an app context is requested.
The only visible exception-type requirement is the broad Exception base class; exact exception types are not asserted.
The app-context branch visibly requires this message fragment.
The no-context branch visibly requires this message fragment.
The app aborter runs only with a context; Werkzeug abort always remains reachable if the app aborter returns normally.

uncertainty.statement: The masked slots do not reveal how _cv_app.get(None), mock_ctx, mock_app, mock_aborter, or _wz_abort are stubbed.
uncertainty.condition: Until a legal masked setup is supplied.

uncertainty.statement: The visible test requires only Exception and message fragments, so an exact exception class cannot be inferred.
